note: Provincial park on Madge Lake near the Manitoba border, in boreal forest. The main campground is Pickerel Point (Birch, Poplar and Spruce loops), with Spruce running out along the wooded point between the lake and a bay; the small non-electric Fern loop (the winter camping loop) lies about 2 km southwest and Selwood about 2.5 km north. Spruce and Selwood are mostly short sites: 41 nightly sites across the park are posted for units of 18 ft or less. --Claude
